title: 擴散爐均勻性控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 爐管與邊界
stages.description: 在「爐管與邊界」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for furnace and boundaries, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 批次位置圖
steps.objective: 完成「批次位置圖」的因果圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for map batch positions, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：批次位置圖。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map batch positions. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「批次位置圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map batch positions and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「批次位置圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for map batch positions: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 批次位置圖的原理
knowledge.text: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。
knowledge.textEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

quiz.question: 評估「批次位置圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating map batch positions?
options: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

steps.title: 晶舟載量
steps.objective: 完成「晶舟載量」的對照表，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：晶舟載量。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：裝片數量及間距改變熱容量與流場。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Specify boat loading. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Wafer count and spacing change thermal mass and flow. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「裝片數量及間距改變熱容量與流場。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Wafer count and spacing change thermal mass and flow. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「晶舟載量」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for specify boat loading and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「晶舟載量」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for specify boat loading: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objective: 完成「爐溫與片溫」的敏感度草圖，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for separate furnace and wafer temperature, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：爐溫與片溫。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：爐壁設定值不能直接當作晶圓瞬時溫度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate furnace and wafer temperature. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Wall setpoint is not instantaneous wafer temperature. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「爐壁設定值不能直接當作晶圓瞬時溫度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Wall setpoint is not instantaneous wafer temperature. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「爐溫與片溫」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate furnace and wafer temperature and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「爐溫與片溫」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for separate furnace and wafer temperature: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 固定源與有限源
steps.objective: 完成「固定源與有限源」的故障判別表，把片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for separate constant and finite sources, connecting relevant limits in slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：固定源與有限源。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：邊界供應條件決定擴散解的形式。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate constant and finite sources. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Source boundary conditions determine the diffusion solution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「邊界供應條件決定擴散解的形式。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Source boundary conditions determine the diffusion solution. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「固定源與有限源」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate constant and finite sources and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「固定源與有限源」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for separate constant and finite sources: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：濃度守恆。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：有限劑量擴散應保持總量，除非另有損失通量。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Check concentration conservation. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Finite-dose diffusion conserves total dose unless a loss flux is specified. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「有限劑量擴散應保持總量，除非另有損失通量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

Interpretation: Nonisothermal histories require integrating temperature-dependent diffusivity. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
